question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given sentence.

The artist's unique technique added a touch of individiuality to the painting.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 1 i.e. Individiuality.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Individuality'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling is 'Individuality'.** However, all the words in the given sentence are correctly spelled, meaning there is no actual incorrect spelling.
 
• The word **'Individuality'** is a **noun** that means the quality or character of a particular person or thing that distinguishes them from others. **(व्यक्तित्व)**
 
 
• **Example:** His individuality sets him apart from the rest of the crowd.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other words:**

 
• **Unique** (अद्वितीय): Being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else.

 
 
• **Example:** Each person's fingerprint is unique.
 
 
 
• **Technique** (तकनीक): A way of carrying out a particular task, especially in the arts or sciences.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist's painting technique is highly advanced.
 
 
 
• **Artist's** (कलाकार का): Possessive form of 'artist,' referring to something belonging to an artist.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist's work was displayed in the gallery.
